source_title: Graves Works 7 Exhaust System for Yamaha R6
description: All Graves Exhaust systems are designed for the elite rider seeking top of the line performance, fit, finish and value. This R6 exhaust system was… • Full titanium headers and mid-pipes. • Strapless muffler design. • Aerospace grade titanium. • Machined joint fittings.
source_description_html:
All Graves Exhaust systems are designed for the elite rider seeking top of the line performance, fit, finish and value. This R6 exhaust system was developed using the same technology that has powered the Monster Energy Graves Yamaha team to 6 consecutive AMA Superbike championships and numerous 600cc championships!

The Graves Works 7 Full exhaust system features titanium headers with an aggressive tapered design with cross-over pipes, these features allow for an increased throttle response and low to mid range power delivery while increasing the peak power output. Graves advanced welding processes reduce oversized welds that can cause excessive heat buildup. A special pipe bending technique known as mandrel bending is used for all Graves exhausts to prevent wrinkles and ovalization of the exhaust pipes. The diamond-shaped muffler matches the aesthetics of the R6's lines and delivers the best possible power and torque. Graves Everlast packing produces an exhaust note like no other and holds up longer to the extreme conditions of a high-revving motorcycle. The muffler mounts directly to the motorcycle instead of using a strap, this not only saves weight but gives the exhaust a stealthy appearance.

Features:

  • Full titanium headers and mid-pipes
  • Strapless muffler design
  • Aerospace grade titanium
  • Machined joint fittings
  • Billet hard anodized 7075T651 aluminum flanges
  • Compatible with OEM and Dynojet O2 sensor
  • Advanced welding process showcases laser perfection welds
  • 11.1 lb in weight saving
  • Made in USA

description: The Graves Exhaust System for the FZ-09, FJ-09 and XSR900 was developed using the same technology that has powered Monster Energy Graves Yamaha riders Josh… • Full titanium headers and mid-pipes. • 8lb weight saving over the OEM exhaust. • Machined joint fittings. • Billet hard anodized 7075T651 aluminum flanges.
source_description_html:
The Graves Exhaust System for the FZ-09, FJ-09 and XSR900 was developed using the same technology that has powered Monster Energy Graves Yamaha riders Josh Hayes and Josh Herrin to consecutive AMA Superbike championships.

The titanium headers feature an aggressive tapered design with cross-over pipes, these features allow for an increased throttle response and low to mid range power delivery while increasing the peak power output. Incorporated into the mid-pipe are two O2 sensor bungs, one for the OEM O2 sensor and the other allows for installation of a Dynojet Auto Tune O2 sensor. Graves advanced welding processes reduce oversized welds that can cause excessive heat buildup. A special pipe bending technique known as mandrel bending is used for all Graves exhausts to prevent wrinkles and ovalization of the exhaust pipes.

The diamond-shaped muffler matches the aesthetics of the Yamaha's lines and delivers the best possible power and torque. Graves Everlast packing produces an exhaust note like no other and holds up longer to the extreme conditions of a high-revving motorcycle. The muffler mounts directly to the motorcycle by way of a carbon fiber strap, this not only saves weight but gives the exhaust a stealthy appearance.

  • Full titanium headers and mid-pipes
  • 11.8lb weight saving over the OEM exhaust
  • Machined joint fittings
  • Billet hard anodized 7075T651 aluminum flanges
  • Dual O2 sensor bungs
  • Includes sound insert
  • Made in USA

Graves Motorsports has taken what they’ve learned from their highly successful AMA team and applied it to these rearsets. Featuring an all CNC billet aluminum construction allows Graves to add strength to certain areas while reducing mass and weight where it is not necessary. The unique adjustable M1 footpegs offer superior grip made possible by the large machined teeth. The pedal tips feature a high grip, rubber peg that ensures positive grip and feel when shifting and braking. The included carbon fiber heel guards are designed to be functional yet look great. Their sturdy and lightweight construction ensures that it will last the repeated boot heel abuse for many seasons. For the smoothest pedal action, Graves has incorporated double roller bearings in the brake and shift pivots.

  • Break-away foot pegs
  • USA grade 7075 and 6061 billet aluminum
  • Double roller bearings

  • GP and Standard Shift compatible
